A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger. He preached these messages several times at different locations over the last ten years. Recently, we had them transcribed and abridged for reading clarity. After printing all six articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant, we will publish them in a booklet. This is the first article of six.

Introduction

My wife and I had the privilege of having a courtship without regrets or guilt. We were blessed with parents who guided us in the right way and gave us opportunities that they didn’t have.

If you don’t have that testimony or memory, please don’t go on a guilt trip. But my prayer for you is that you get a burning burden and vision in your heart to have it for your children. That can be your reward.

A Christ-centered courtship is a period of time between a single life and a married life. The decisions you make in this period will affect you for the rest of your lives. With God’s blessing on your life, you can end up with no regrets or guilt.

Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series.

Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children.

Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers.

Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives.

Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character.

Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.

God’s Plan for Male and Female

Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” My desire is that each one of you, remember your Creator in the days of your youth. Turn your heart, your focus, and your life to pursue after your Creator, Almighty God, in heaven.

What does he mean, “while the evil days come not” and “the years draw nigh”? It means to seek the Lord when you’re young. Take the energy of your youth and seek after God. Young people, you’re young and full of ideas, visions, plans, and dreams. I doubt there are any of you who just enjoy sitting down in an easy chair, putting your feet up, and just dreaming about how terrible and horrible life is going to be. We don’t do that, do we? But if we don’t walk with God and follow God’s plan, hard things will come upon us. When hard things come in life, we have no place to turn to. We dream that life will turn out well. The decisions and actions in our youth affect us for the rest of our lives. The good news is they can affect us in a good way. The bad news is they can affect us in a bad way. It depends on what decisions and choices we make. But young people, you’re young, and you have the opportunity to choose.

Let’s go to the beginning of Genesis.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” God said He would do that.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). God made. God created us male and female. It takes a lot of blind faith to believe that we evolved perfectly as male and female. The creation of male and female is God’s plan. It is one of the living proofs of Creation. God made. God created. It’s God’s plan. God is the Author. And God’s plan brings blessing.

I’d like to look at ten different aspects of this blessing of God’s plan.

1) God brings Eve to Adam.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. Then God created Eve and brought her to Adam. Adam awoke and realized, “This one is for me!” He had seen all the animals go by when he named them. Now God brings him someone that is for him. He also realized, “She was taken out of my side.” She’s close to his heart. “This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.” It’s not a dog; it’s not a giraffe, or a monkey, or an ape. This one that God brought to him is like him. God’s plan has a blessing.

Adam and Eve had never had a companion before. Adam and Eve had never let the emotions of their heart go before. Something happened in Adam and Eve’s hearts. Adam was a “one-woman man,” and Eve was a “one-man woman.” They never gave their heart passions to anybody else. God has that plan for us, too. God’s plan brings blessings.

2) Leaving and cleaving in unity for life.

“Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

This verse says, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,” but Adam and Eve did not have a father and mother. What God is saying it doesn’t work for there to be cleaving unless there’s leaving. Also, in Mark 10:7, we read, “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.” This is God’s plan, and God’s plan brings blessing.

Leaving means to leave behind, to abandon. “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother” is to leave parents leave behind. Let’s consider a young man who has a really good home life. He’s blessed and has everything he needs. Yet once God brings his Eve into his life, something rises up inside him, and he says, “I’m leaving!” But this is God’s plan. And God’s plan brings blessing.

It’s not just leaving his father and mother; he also cleaves to his wife. Cleave means “to glue to, to adhere.” We are very familiar with glued wood panels. All kinds of solid furniture are made out of panels glued together. And if they’re glued together right, they will not come apart at the joints. If you tear them apart, you’re going to have to tear the wood apart. God’s glue is the same way, where it glues two people together. The only way to tear them apart is by splintering and ripping and God does not bless that. But leaving and cleaving, staying together and being glued together, that’s God’s plan and it brings blessing.

3) They shall be one flesh.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Two single people who become one married couple, become one unit before God, and become one family before God. They become one flesh, where God sees them as together as one.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). God’s plan for male and female is that He brings Eve to Adam. Then the leaving and cleaving to take place. He causes them to become one flesh. Pulling apart is no blessing at all but bringsagony,pain,travail, and hurt. There is no blessing in separation. But God’s plan brings blessing.

4) Not an unequal yoke.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

God’s plan is that marriage is an equal yoke. God will not bring an Eve to an Adam in a marriage that is an unequal yoke.Let’s think about leaving and cleaving, getting glued together, and two becoming one. In marriage, those two are now one before God. Imagine being in a bad marriage relationship like this—a family like this trying to function together. There will be no blessing.

But an equal yoke brings blessing! God desires that we be joined together in one flesh, one heart, and one mind. He wants to see us joined in heart, mind, and fleashthe whole being, being one. God’s plan brings blessing.

5) God planned for us to have children.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Think of the joy and miracle every time another child is born into a Christian home. God planned it this way. And if God brought Adam his Eve, and they leave and cleave, they become one flesh, one heart, one mind. If they are equally yoked and God blesses them with children, it becomes a joyful haven where God can dwell. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). God’s plan brings blessing.

6) Headship order.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). It is God, and then Christ, the man, and the woman. God established a headship order, and this headship order is a blessing. It’s God’s plan, and it’s a blessing.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Children, obey your parents in the Lord is a part of the headship order. This not difficult to understand, is it? A home following the plan of God is just a blessed situation. Young people learn to be under authority. Make that your high priority. The sooner you learn to be under authority, the better you will be prepared for the responsibilities in life.

I remember looking at married life and having aspirations about teaching children and raising a godly family. I listened to the “Godly Home” series and thought I was ready to go. But then the day came when it was my turn and my responsibility, and all of a sudden, my heart wanted to wither. Responsibility doesn’t feel the same as dreaming about it does. YOU need to do something! YOU are responsible. YOU need to make it happen. And, by the way, not just make it happen; you need to make it happen in a Christlike way. You need to make it happen in a way that the anointing of the Spirit of God can come down on your family. The better we learn how to be under authority, the better we’ll be prepared for those responsibilities. The more we realize we need God, the better off we are. Let’s make a high priority out of learning to be under authority as children and as young people. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

God will add his blessing if we stay in this headship order. The more you learn how to be under authority, the more you will be blessed when you establish your home. God’s plan has blessings.

7) A godly marriage.

Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

First of all look at verse 21, “submitting yourselves one to another.” There’s a blending together that needs to happen in a godly home. This blending together should happen in the fear of God. If we’re submitting one to another in the fear of God, we’re going to obey God because we want His blessings.

Ephesians 5: 22, 24 “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” Young ladies, you can count on it: submission to Dad equals submission to a husband. You can practice while you are single. This will help build character in your life. Being a rebellious and froward woman is not going to bring the blessing of God.

It goes on and says, in Ephesians 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Young men, this says that husbands should love their wives. So who do you think God put in your life to prepare you to love your wife? Your mother! Do you want to learn how to love your wife? Learn how to get along with your mom, love your mom, and care about her. Do you want to practice to love your future wife? Go ahead and love your mom.

Verse 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” God’s plan brings blessings.

8) Being heirs together of the grace of life.

1 Peter 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” As husbands, we give honor to the wife. She is the weaker vessel and the one that born the children! She’s gone through a lot of traumatic changes in her life. She’s the one that gets worn out and tires sooner.

And he says, “Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.”

Young men, learn to understand your mom and your sisters. It will help you after you get married. Don’t conclude that—ah, that’s just women. No, you want the blessing of God. Learn to know and understand them.

“Being heirs together of the grace of life.” God wants us to be heirs together of the grace of life. If we’re not heirs together of the grace of life, can we be heirs separated of the grace of life? I don’t think so. He says we should be heirs together so that our prayers are not hindered. So if we’re heirs separated, could we say our prayers will be hindered? Yes, our prayers will be hindered. Let’s give honor unto the wife as unto the weaker vessel. Every ounce you can gain in this area will only bless you later. It’s worth it. God’s plan brings blessing.

9) A blessed and secure home.

This comes partly out of 1 Peter 3:7, but also from Psalm 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” The grace of God is on a secure home where there is unity. Where Dad is understanding Mom, where Dad cares about Mom. Dad is ministering and is there to help and guide. He’s there to give direction with a heart of compassion. God’s plan for male and female—God’s plan brings blessings.

10) As Christ and the church.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” God is looking for men who are willing to give their lives. Single young men, who are willing to answer the call and give their life. This is a high calling of God. It’s the plan of God.

Young men, are you willing to lay down your life, your agenda, and those independent things you like to do? Are you willing to be patient, gentle, and understanding? Are you willing to lose sleep and keep going even when you’re tired? Are you willing to stay calm and not react in stressful circumstances? Are you willing to lead and guide a wife and children, eternal souls, through this life?

But my plea is that you would volunteer and say, “I’m willing to apply myself to the Word of God, the will of God, the plan of God, and I’ll give my life. I’m willing to lay it on the altar.” Jesus gave His life for us, and He’s comparing the marriage with the church and Him.

There’s also a need for mothers who are submissive and yielded to authority. Mothers who do not follow the women’s lib of our day but are rather content to be keepers at home.

Young ladies, are you willing to enlist? Will you give your heart to be guided and led? Are you willing to follow and to cheerfully submit to your authority? Are you willing to serve and be spent for your family? Are you willing to serve and be spent for YOUR family? If you get married someday, it will be YOUR family that you’ll be serving and being spent for. Are you willing to bear pain and discomfort? Are you willing to be a helpmeet, giving yourself for his burden and vision?

But as we look at God’s plan and blessings, you want God’s blessing, young people! But that means you need to make choices accordingly. Rise up and make decisions that will lead to maturity. Maturity comes with the process of seeking after God. Make a commitment in your heart to open yourself to God’s blessings and principles. I encourage you to walk with God, to have a relationship with Jesus Christ, and to do so in humility.

Seek after Christlike character, and do it on purpose. It is so easy for us to just live life however it happens. But if we make decisions on purpose, it will take us somewhere! Those decisions matter. Do things according to God’s plan.

God has a plan for male and female and he has a plan for you.

En Kristuscentrerad förlovning är en serie predikningar om gudsfruktig förlovning av Paul Hershberger. Han predikade dessa budskap flera gånger på olika platser under de senaste tio åren. Nyligen lät vi dem transkriberas och förkorta dem för läsbarhet. Efter att ha tryckt alla sex artiklar i The Heartbeat of the Remnant kommer vi att ge ut dem i en broschyr. Detta är den första av sex artiklar.

Introduction

Min fru och jag hade privilegiet att ha en förlovning utan ånger eller skuld. Vi blev välsignade med föräldrar som vägledde oss på rätt sätt och gav oss möjligheter som de inte hade.

Om du inte har det vittnesbördet eller det minnet, snälla låt det inte bli en skuldkänsla. Men min förbön för dig är att du får en brinnande börda och vision i ditt hjärta att ha det för dina barn. Det kan bli din belöning.

En Kristuscentrerad förlovning är en tidsperiod mellan singelliv och äktenskapligt liv. De beslut du fattar under denna tid kommer att påverka dig resten av ditt liv. Med Guds välsignelse över ditt liv kan du sluta utan ånger eller skuld.

Fem mål för denna serie om Kristuscentrerad förlovning.

Mål nr 1. Att vända fädernas hjärtan till deras barn.

Mål nr 2. Att vända barnens hjärtan till deras fäder.

Mål nr 3. Att föräldrar får en börda att leda var och en av sina barn in i Guds fullkomliga vilja för deras liv.

Mål nr 4. Att ungdomar får en börda att söka efter Gud, finna uppfyllelse och mening i att vandra med Gud, och att ni söker mognad i ert uppförande och i er karaktär.

Mål nr 5. Att unga män och unga kvinnor reser sig för att bli gudfruktiga fäder och gudfruktiga mödrar med en vision att uppfostra en ny gudfruktig generation, så att Jesu Kristi evangelium kan fortsätta.

Guds plan för man och kvinna

Predikaren 12:1 säger: "Kom ihåg din Skapare i dina ungdoms dagar, innan de onda dagarna kommer och åren kommer, då du säger: Jag har ingen glädje i dem." Min önskan är att var och en av er skall komma ihåg er Skapare i era ungdoms dagar. Vänd ert hjärta, er fokus och ert liv att söka efter er Skapare, den Allsmäktige Guden i himlen.

Vad menar han med "innan de onda dagarna kommer" och "åren drar nära"? Det betyder att söka Herren medan du är ung. Använd ungdomen energi och sök efter Gud. Ungdomar, ni är unga och fulla av idéer, visioner, planer och drömmar. Jag tvivlar på att någon av er bara njuter av att sitta ner i en bekväm fåtölj, lägga upp fötterna och drömma om hur hemskt och fruktansvärt livet ska bli. Vi gör inte det, eller hur? Men om vi inte vandrar med Gud och följer Guds plan, kommer svåra saker över oss. När svårigheter kommer i livet har vi ingenstans att vända oss. Vi drömmer att livet ska gå väl. Besluten och handlingarna i vår ungdom påverkar oss för resten av våra liv. Den goda nyheten är att de kan påverka oss på ett gott sätt. Den dåliga nyheten är att de kan påverka oss på ett dåligt sätt. Det beror på vilka beslut och val vi gör. Men ungdomar, ni är unga och ni har möjlighet att välja.

Låt oss gå till början i Första Mosebok.

"Och HERREN Gud sade: Det är inte gott att människan är allena; jag vill göra en hjälp för henne som är henne såsom motpart. Och av jorden bildade HERREN Gud alla markens fyrfota djur och alla himlens fåglar och förde dem till människan för att se vad hon skulle kalla dem; och vad mäniskan än kallade vart levande väsen, det skulle det heta. Och människan gav namn åt allt kreatur och åt himlens fåglar och åt allt de markens djur, men för människan fann man ingen hjälp som var henne såsom motpart. Då lät HERREN Gud falla en djup sömn på människan, och hon sov; och han tog ett av hennes revben och fyllde igen köttet därmed. Och av det revben som HERREN Gud tagit av människan byggde han en kvinna och förde henne till människan. Då sade människan: Nu är denna ben av mina ben och kött av mitt kött; hon skall kallas kvinna, därför att hon är tagen av mannen. Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor och hålla sig till sin hustru, och de två skola vara ett kött." (Första Mosebok 2:18-24).

"Och Gud sade: Låt oss göra människor till vår avbild, så att de äro oss likna; och de skola råda över havets fiskar och himlens fåglar och boskapen och över hela jorden och över alla kräldjur som kräla på jorden. Och Gud skapade människan till sin avbild, till Guds avbild skapade han henne; till man och kvinna skapade han dem. Och Gud välsignade dem och Gud sade till dem: Var fruktsamma och föröka eder och uppfyll jorden och råda däröver; och råda över havets fiskar och himlens fåglar och över allt levande, som rör sig på jorden." (Första Mosebok 1:26-28).

"Och HERREN Gud sade: Det är inte gott att människan är allena; jag vill göra en hjälp som är henne såsom motpart." (Första Mosebok 2:18). "Jag skall göra åt honom en hjälp som är honom såsom motpart." Gud sade att han skulle göra det.

"Och Gud skapade människan till sin avbild, till Guds avbild skapade han henne; till man och kvinna skapade han dem." (Första Mosebok 1:27). Gud gjorde. Gud skapade oss till man och kvinna. Det krävs mycket blind tro för att tro att vi perfekt utvecklades som man och kvinna. Skapelsen av man och kvinna är Guds plan. Det är ett av levande bevisen för skapelsen. Gud gjorde. Gud skapade. Det är Guds plan. Gud är Författaren. Och Guds plan medför välsignelse.

Jag vill titta på tio olika aspekter av denna välsignelse i Guds plan.

1) Gud för Eva till Adam.

"Och det revben som HERREN Gud tagit av människan byggde han en kvinna och förde henne till människan. Och människan sade: Detta är nu ben av mina ben och kött av mitt kött; hon skall kallas kvinna, därför att hon är tagen av mannen." (Första Mosebok 2:22-23).

Gud lät människan falla i en djup sömn. Sedan skapade Gud Eva och förde henne till Adam. Adam vaknade och insåg: "Denna är för mig!" Han hade sett allt djurfolk gå förbi när han namngav dem. Nu för Gud honom någon som är för honom. Han insåg också: "Hon togs ur min sida." Hon är nära hans hjärta. "Detta är ben av mina ben och kött av mitt kött." Det är inte en hund; det är inte en giraff, eller en apa. Denna som Gud förde till honom är lik honom. Guds plan har en välsignelse.

Adam och Eva hade aldrig haft en följeslagare tidigare. Adam och Eva hade aldrig låtit hjärtats känslor gå före. Något hände i Adam och Evas hjärtan. Adam blev en "en-kvinna-man", och Eva blev en "en-man-kvinna." De gav aldrig sina hjärtepassioner åt någon annan. Gud har den planen för oss också. Guds plan medför välsignelser.

2) Att lämna och hålla sig intill i enhet för livet.

"Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor och hålla sig till sin hustru, och de två skola vara ett kött." (Första Mosebok 2:24).

Denna vers säger: "Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor," men Adam och Eva hade ingen far och mor. Vad Gud säger är att det inte fungerar att hålla sig intill om det inte finns ett lämnande. Också i Markus 10:7 läser vi: "Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor och hålla sig intill sin hustru." Detta är Guds plan, och Guds plan medför välsignelse.

Att lämna betyder att lämna bakom sig, att överge. "Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor" betyder att lämna föräldrarna bakom sig. Tänk på en ung man som har ett mycket gott hem. Han är välsignad och har allt han behöver. Ändå, när Gud för hans Eva in i hans liv, stiger något upp inom honom och han säger: "Jag lämnar!" Men detta är Guds plan. Och Guds plan medför välsignelse.

Det är inte bara att lämna sin far och mor; han håller sig också intill sin hustru. Hålla sig intill betyder "att fästa vid, att hålla fast vid." Vi är mycket bekanta med limmade träskivor. Alla slags solida möbler görs av skivor limmade tillsammans. Och om de limmas rätt, kommer de inte att gå isär vid fogarna. Om du sliter dem isär, måste du riva sönder träet. Guds lim är likadant, det limmar två människor samman. Det enda sättet att dra dem isär är att splittra och riva sönder, och Gud välsignar inte det. Men att lämna och hålla sig intill, att stanna tillsammans och vara limmade ihop, det är Guds plan och det medför välsignelse.

3) De skola vara ett kött.

"Därför skall en man lämna sin far och sin mor och hålla sig till sin hustru, och de två skola vara ett kött." (Första Mosebok 2:24). Två ogifta människor som blir ett gift par blir en enhet inför Gud och blir en familj inför Gud. De blir ett kött, där Gud ser dem tillsammans som en helhet.

"Och de två skola vara ett kött; så äro de icke mer två, utan ett kött. Vad därför Gud har fogat samman, må inte människan skilja." (Markus 10:8-9). Guds plan för man och kvinna är att han för Eva till Adam. Sedan skall lämningen och hålla sig intill ske. Han gör dem till ett kött. Att rycka isär är ingen välsignelse utan medför plåga, smärta, vedermödor och sår. Det finns ingen välsignelse i separation. Men Guds plan medför välsignelse.

4) Inte en ojämn åk.

"Var icke oförenligt ihop med dem som icke tror; vilken samfälldhet kan rättfärdigheten hava med ogärningen?" (2 Korintierbrevet 6:14-15). "Hustrun är förpliktigad genom lagen så länge hennes man lever; men är hennes man död, så är hon fri att bli gift med vem hon vill, så vitt det sker i Herren." (1 Korintierbrevet 7:39).

Guds plan är att äktenskapet är en jämn åk. Gud kommer inte att föra en Eva till en Adam i ett äktenskap som är en ojämn åk. Låt oss tänka på att lämna och hålla sig intill, bli limmade ihop och två bli ett. I äktenskapet är dessa två nu ett inför Gud. Föreställ dig att vara i ett dåligt äktenskapsförhållande—en familj som försöker fungera tillsammans på det sättet. Det kommer inte att finnas någon välsignelse.

Men en jämn åk ger välsignelse! Gud önskar att vi blir förenade i ett kött, ett hjärta och ett sinne. Han vill se oss förenade i hjärta, sinne och kött—hela varan som ett. Guds plan medför välsignelse.

5) Gud planerade att vi skulle få barn.

"Och Gud välsignade dem och Gud sade till dem: Var fruktsamma och föröka eder och uppfyll jorden och råda däröver; och råda över havets fiskar och himlens fåglar och över allt levande, som rör sig på jorden." (Första Mosebok 1:28). Tänk på glädjen och miraklet varje gång ett barn föds in i ett kristet hem. Gud planerade det så. Och om Gud för Adam hans Eva, och de lämnar och håller sig intill, blir ett kött, ett hjärta, ett sinne. Om de är jämnt åkta och Gud välsignar dem med barn, blir det en glad tillflykt där Gud kan bo. "Och Gud välsignade Noa och hans söner och sade till dem: Var fruktsamma och föröka eder och uppfyll jorden." (Första Mosebok 9:1). "Ni, var fruktsamma och föröka eder; må ni bli talrika i landet och förökas där." (Första Mosebok 9:7). Guds plan medför välsignelse.

6) Ledarskapsordning.

"Jag vill dock att I känna till detta: Varje man är Kristi huvud, kvinnans huvud är mannen, och Kristi huvud är Gud." (1 Korintierbrevet 11:3). Det är Gud, sedan Kristus, mannen och kvinnan. Gud har upprättat en ordning för ledarskap, och denna ordning är en välsignelse. Det är Guds plan, och det är en välsignelse.

"Barn, lyd era föräldrar i Herren, ty detta är rätt. Hedra din far och din mor, detta är det första budet med löfte: för att det må gå dig väl och du må leva länge i landet." (Efesierbrevet 6:1-3). Barn, lyd era föräldrar i Herren är en del av ledarskapsordningen. Det är inte svårt att förstå, eller hur? Ett hem som följer Guds plan är helt enkelt en välsignad situation. Ungdomar lär sig att vara under auktoritet. Gör det till en hög prioritet. Ju tidigare ni lär er att vara under auktoritet, desto bättre blir ni förberedda för livets ansvar.

Jag minns att jag såg på det gifta livet och hade strävanden om att undervisa barn och uppfostra en gudfruktig familj. Jag lyssnade på serien "Gudligt hem" och trodde att jag var redo att gå. Men sedan kom dagen då det var min tur och mitt ansvar, och plötsligt ville mitt hjärta vissna. Ansvar känns inte likadant som att drömma om det gör. DU behöver göra något! DU är ansvarig. DU behöver få det att hända. Och förresten, inte bara få det att hända; du behöver få det att hända på ett Kristuslikt sätt. Du behöver få det att hända så att Herrens Ande kan komma över ditt hem. Ju bättre vi lär oss att vara under auktoritet, desto bättre blir vi förberedda för de ansvarsområdena. Ju mer vi inser att vi behöver Gud, desto bättre är vi. Låt oss göra det till en hög prioritet att lära oss att vara under auktoritet som barn och som ungdomar. "Min son, glöm icke min undervisning, utan låt ditt hjärta bevara mina bud; ty långa dagar och många år och frid skola tillfogas dig." (Ordspråksboken 3:1-2).

Gud skall lägga till sin välsignelse om vi stannar i denna ledarskapsordning. Ju mer du lär dig att vara under auktoritet, desto mer skall du bli välsignad när du upprättar ditt hem. Guds plan har välsignelser.

7) Ett gudfruktigt äktenskap.

Efesierbrevet 5:21,22,24 säger: "Underordna er varandra i fruktan för Kristus. Hustrur, underordna er era män såsom under Herren. ... Så som församlingen är underordnad Kristus, så skolen också hustrurna vara sina män underordnade i allt."

Först, se på vers 21, "Underordna er varandra." Det behöver ske en förening i ett gudfruktigt hem. Denna förening bör ske i Guds fruktan. Om vi underordnar oss varandra i Guds fruktan, kommer vi att lyda Gud därför att vi vill ha hans välsignelser.

Efesierbrevet 5:22,24 "Hustrur, underordna er era män såsom under Herren. ... Så som församlingen är underordnad Kristus, så skolen också hustrurna vara sina män underordnade i allt." Unga damer, ni kan räkna med det: underordning mot pappa motsvarar underordning mot en make. Ni kan öva medan ni är ogifta. Detta kommer att hjälpa bygga karaktär i ert liv. Att vara en upprorisk och besvärlig kvinna kommer inte att föra Guds välsignelse med sig.

Det fortsätter och säger, i Efesierbrevet 5:25,28,29: "Män, älska era hustrur, såsom också Kristus älskade församlingen och utgav sig själv för den ... Så skola män älska sina hustrur såsom sina egna kroppar. Den som älskar sin hustru älskar sig själv. Ty ingen någonsin hatat sitt eget kött, utan han när och vårdar det, såsom också Kristus gör med församlingen." Unga män, detta säger att makar skall älska sina hustrur. Så vem tror ni att Gud satte i ert liv för att förbereda er att älska er hustru? Er mor! Vill ni lära er att älska er hustru? Lär er att komma överens med er mor, älska er mor och bry er om henne. Vill ni öva på att älska er framtida hustru? Gå vidare och älska er mor.

Vers 33, "I synnerhet må var och en av eder älska sin hustru såsom sig själv, och må hustrun aktas av sin man." Guds plan medför välsignelser.

8) Att vara arvingar tillsammans av livets nåd.

1 Petrusbrevet 3:7 "Likaså, I män, lev med era hustrur efter kunskap och hav aktning för kvinnan såsom svagare kärl, och som arvingar tillsammans av nåden till livet, så att icke era böner komma till korta." Som män ger vi aktning åt hustrun. Hon är det svagare kärlet och den som fött barnen! Hon har gått igenom många omvälvande förändringar i sitt liv. Hon är den som blir uttröttad och tröttnar fortare.

Och han säger: "Män, lev med dem efter kunskap."

Unga män, lär er att förstå er mor och era systrar. Det kommer att hjälpa er efter att ni gifter er. Dra inte slutsatsen att—ah, det är bara kvinnor. Nej, ni vill ha Guds välsignelse. Lär er känna och förstå dem.

"Som arvingar tillsammans av nåden till livet." Gud vill att vi skall vara arvingar tillsammans av livets nåd. Om vi inte är arvingar tillsammans av livets nåd, kan vi vara arvingar åtskilda av livets nåd? Jag tror inte det. Han säger att vi skall vara arvingar tillsammans så att våra böner inte blir hindrade. Så om vi är arvingar åtskilda, kan vi säga att våra böner blir hindrade? Ja, våra böner blir hindrade. Låt oss ge aktning åt hustrun såsom åt det svagare kärlet. Varje uns ni vinner i detta område kommer bara att välsigna er senare. Det är värt det. Guds plan medför välsignelse.

9) Ett välsignat och tryggt hem.

Detta kommer delvis ur 1 Petrus 3:7, men också från Psaltaren 144:12: "Så att våra söner må växa upp såsom plantor i deras ungdom; att våra döttrar må vara såsom hörnstenar, putsade efter ett palats liknelse." Guds nåd är över ett tryggt hem där det finns enhet. Där fadern förstår modern, där fadern bryr sig om modern. Fadern tjänar och är där för att hjälpa och vägleda. Han är där för att ge riktning med ett barmhärtigt hjärta. Guds plan för man och kvinna—Guds plan medför välsignelser.

10) Som Kristus och församlingen.

"Så som församlingen är underordnad Kristus, så skolen också hustrurna vara sina män underordnade i allt. Män, älska era hustrur, såsom också Kristus älskade församlingen och utgav sig själv för den; för att han skulle helga och rena den genom dopets bad i Ordet, för att han skulle kunna uppställa den inför sig själv en härlig församling, utan fläck eller rynka eller något sådant, utan att den skulle vara helig och fläckfri. Så skola män älska sina hustrur såsom sina egna kroppar. Den som älskar sin hustru älskar sig själv. Ty ingen någonsin hatat sitt eget kött, utan han när och vårdar det, såsom också Herren församlingen." (Efesierbrevet 5:24-29).

"Män, älska era hustrur, såsom också Kristus älskade församlingen och utgav sig själv för den." Gud söker män som är villiga att ge sina liv. Ogifta unga män, är ni villiga att svara kallelsen och ge ert liv? Detta är ett högt kall från Gud. Det är Guds plan.

Unga män, är ni villiga att lägga ner ert liv, er agenda och de där självständiga saker ni tycker om att göra? Är ni villiga att vara tåliga, milda och förstående? Är ni villiga att förlora sömn och fortsätta även när ni är trötta? Är ni villiga att förbli lugna och inte reagera i stressiga omständigheter? Är ni villiga att leda och vägleda en hustru och barn, eviga själar, genom detta liv?

Men min vädjan är att ni frivilligt skall säga: "Jag är villig att tillämpa mig på Guds Ord, Guds vilja, Guds plan, och jag ska ge mitt liv. Jag är villig att lägga det på altaret." Jesus gav sitt liv för oss, och han jämför äktenskapet med församlingen och sig själv.

Det finns även behov av mödrar som är ödmjuka och lydiga under auktoritet. Mödrar som inte följer vår tids kvinnofrigörelse utan snarare är belåtna att vara hemmets vaktare.

Unga damer, är ni villiga att gå med? Vill ni ge ert hjärta för att bli vägledda och ledda? Är ni villiga att följa och med glädje underordna er er auktoritet? Är ni villiga att tjäna och bli uthärdade för er familj? Är ni villiga att tjäna och bli uthärdade för ER familj? Om ni gifter er någon dag, blir det ER familj som ni ska tjäna och uthärda för. Är ni villiga att bära smärta och obehag? Är ni villiga att vara en hjälp som skänker er själva för hans börda och vision?

Men när vi ser på Guds plan och välsignelser, så vill ni ha Guds välsignelse, ungdomar! Men det betyder att ni måste fatta val därefter. Res er upp och fatta beslut som leder till mognad. Mognad kommer med processen att söka efter Gud. Gå in för i ert hjärta att öppna er för Guds välsignelser och principer. Jag uppmuntrar er att vandra med Gud, att ha en relation med Jesus Kristus och att göra det i ödmjukhet.

Sök efter Kristuslik karaktär och gör det med avsikt. Det är så lätt för oss att bara leva livet hur det nu blir. Men om vi tar beslut med avsikt, kommer det att föra oss någonstans! Dessa beslut har betydelse. Gör saker enligt Guds plan.

Gud har en plan för man och kvinna och han har en plan för dig.

A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger. He preached these messages several times at different locations over the last ten years. Recently, we had them transcribed and abridged for reading clarity. After printing all six articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant, we will publish them in a booklet. This is the first article of six.

Introduction

My wife and I had the privilege of having a courtship without regrets or guilt. We were blessed with parents who guided us in the right way and gave us opportunities that they didn’t have.

If you don’t have that testimony or memory, please don’t go on a guilt trip. But my prayer for you is that you get a burning burden and vision in your heart to have it for your children. That can be your reward.

A Christ-centered courtship is a period of time between a single life and a married life. The decisions you make in this period will affect you for the rest of your lives. With God’s blessing on your life, you can end up with no regrets or guilt.

Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series.

Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children.

Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers.

Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives.

Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character.

Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.

God’s Plan for Male and Female

Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” My desire is that each one of you, remember your Creator in the days of your youth. Turn your heart, your focus, and your life to pursue after your Creator, Almighty God, in heaven.

What does he mean, “while the evil days come not” and “the years draw nigh”? It means to seek the Lord when you’re young. Take the energy of your youth and seek after God. Young people, you’re young and full of ideas, visions, plans, and dreams. I doubt there are any of you who just enjoy sitting down in an easy chair, putting your feet up, and just dreaming about how terrible and horrible life is going to be. We don’t do that, do we? But if we don’t walk with God and follow God’s plan, hard things will come upon us. When hard things come in life, we have no place to turn to. We dream that life will turn out well. The decisions and actions in our youth affect us for the rest of our lives. The good news is they can affect us in a good way. The bad news is they can affect us in a bad way. It depends on what decisions and choices we make. But young people, you’re young, and you have the opportunity to choose.

Let’s go to the beginning of Genesis.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” God said He would do that.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). God made. God created us male and female. It takes a lot of blind faith to believe that we evolved perfectly as male and female. The creation of male and female is God’s plan. It is one of the living proofs of Creation. God made. God created. It’s God’s plan. God is the Author. And God’s plan brings blessing.

I’d like to look at ten different aspects of this blessing of God’s plan.

1) God brings Eve to Adam.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. Then God created Eve and brought her to Adam. Adam awoke and realized, “This one is for me!” He had seen all the animals go by when he named them. Now God brings him someone that is for him. He also realized, “She was taken out of my side.” She’s close to his heart. “This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.” It’s not a dog; it’s not a giraffe, or a monkey, or an ape. This one that God brought to him is like him. God’s plan has a blessing.

Adam and Eve had never had a companion before. Adam and Eve had never let the emotions of their heart go before. Something happened in Adam and Eve’s hearts. Adam was a “one-woman man,” and Eve was a “one-man woman.” They never gave their heart passions to anybody else. God has that plan for us, too. God’s plan brings blessings.

2) Leaving and cleaving in unity for life.

“Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

This verse says, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,” but Adam and Eve did not have a father and mother. What God is saying it doesn’t work for there to be cleaving unless there’s leaving. Also, in Mark 10:7, we read, “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.” This is God’s plan, and God’s plan brings blessing.

Leaving means to leave behind, to abandon. “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother” is to leave parents leave behind. Let’s consider a young man who has a really good home life. He’s blessed and has everything he needs. Yet once God brings his Eve into his life, something rises up inside him, and he says, “I’m leaving!” But this is God’s plan. And God’s plan brings blessing.

It’s not just leaving his father and mother; he also cleaves to his wife. Cleave means “to glue to, to adhere.” We are very familiar with glued wood panels. All kinds of solid furniture are made out of panels glued together. And if they’re glued together right, they will not come apart at the joints. If you tear them apart, you’re going to have to tear the wood apart. God’s glue is the same way, where it glues two people together. The only way to tear them apart is by splintering and ripping and God does not bless that. But leaving and cleaving, staying together and being glued together, that’s God’s plan and it brings blessing.

3) They shall be one flesh.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Two single people who become one married couple, become one unit before God, and become one family before God. They become one flesh, where God sees them as together as one.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). God’s plan for male and female is that He brings Eve to Adam. Then the leaving and cleaving to take place. He causes them to become one flesh. Pulling apart is no blessing at all but bringsagony,pain,travail, and hurt. There is no blessing in separation. But God’s plan brings blessing.

4) Not an unequal yoke.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

God’s plan is that marriage is an equal yoke. God will not bring an Eve to an Adam in a marriage that is an unequal yoke.Let’s think about leaving and cleaving, getting glued together, and two becoming one. In marriage, those two are now one before God. Imagine being in a bad marriage relationship like this—a family like this trying to function together. There will be no blessing.

But an equal yoke brings blessing! God desires that we be joined together in one flesh, one heart, and one mind. He wants to see us joined in heart, mind, and fleashthe whole being, being one. God’s plan brings blessing.

5) God planned for us to have children.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Think of the joy and miracle every time another child is born into a Christian home. God planned it this way. And if God brought Adam his Eve, and they leave and cleave, they become one flesh, one heart, one mind. If they are equally yoked and God blesses them with children, it becomes a joyful haven where God can dwell. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). God’s plan brings blessing.

6) Headship order.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). It is God, and then Christ, the man, and the woman. God established a headship order, and this headship order is a blessing. It’s God’s plan, and it’s a blessing.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Children, obey your parents in the Lord is a part of the headship order. This not difficult to understand, is it? A home following the plan of God is just a blessed situation. Young people learn to be under authority. Make that your high priority. The sooner you learn to be under authority, the better you will be prepared for the responsibilities in life.

I remember looking at married life and having aspirations about teaching children and raising a godly family. I listened to the “Godly Home” series and thought I was ready to go. But then the day came when it was my turn and my responsibility, and all of a sudden, my heart wanted to wither. Responsibility doesn’t feel the same as dreaming about it does. YOU need to do something! YOU are responsible. YOU need to make it happen. And, by the way, not just make it happen; you need to make it happen in a Christlike way. You need to make it happen in a way that the anointing of the Spirit of God can come down on your family. The better we learn how to be under authority, the better we’ll be prepared for those responsibilities. The more we realize we need God, the better off we are. Let’s make a high priority out of learning to be under authority as children and as young people. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

God will add his blessing if we stay in this headship order. The more you learn how to be under authority, the more you will be blessed when you establish your home. God’s plan has blessings.

7) A godly marriage.

Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

First of all look at verse 21, “submitting yourselves one to another.” There’s a blending together that needs to happen in a godly home. This blending together should happen in the fear of God. If we’re submitting one to another in the fear of God, we’re going to obey God because we want His blessings.

Ephesians 5: 22, 24 “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” Young ladies, you can count on it: submission to Dad equals submission to a husband. You can practice while you are single. This will help build character in your life. Being a rebellious and froward woman is not going to bring the blessing of God.

It goes on and says, in Ephesians 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Young men, this says that husbands should love their wives. So who do you think God put in your life to prepare you to love your wife? Your mother! Do you want to learn how to love your wife? Learn how to get along with your mom, love your mom, and care about her. Do you want to practice to love your future wife? Go ahead and love your mom.

Verse 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” God’s plan brings blessings.

8) Being heirs together of the grace of life.

1 Peter 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” As husbands, we give honor to the wife. She is the weaker vessel and the one that born the children! She’s gone through a lot of traumatic changes in her life. She’s the one that gets worn out and tires sooner.

And he says, “Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.”

Young men, learn to understand your mom and your sisters. It will help you after you get married. Don’t conclude that—ah, that’s just women. No, you want the blessing of God. Learn to know and understand them.

“Being heirs together of the grace of life.” God wants us to be heirs together of the grace of life. If we’re not heirs together of the grace of life, can we be heirs separated of the grace of life? I don’t think so. He says we should be heirs together so that our prayers are not hindered. So if we’re heirs separated, could we say our prayers will be hindered? Yes, our prayers will be hindered. Let’s give honor unto the wife as unto the weaker vessel. Every ounce you can gain in this area will only bless you later. It’s worth it. God’s plan brings blessing.

9) A blessed and secure home.

This comes partly out of 1 Peter 3:7, but also from Psalm 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” The grace of God is on a secure home where there is unity. Where Dad is understanding Mom, where Dad cares about Mom. Dad is ministering and is there to help and guide. He’s there to give direction with a heart of compassion. God’s plan for male and female—God’s plan brings blessings.

10) As Christ and the church.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” God is looking for men who are willing to give their lives. Single young men, who are willing to answer the call and give their life. This is a high calling of God. It’s the plan of God.

Young men, are you willing to lay down your life, your agenda, and those independent things you like to do? Are you willing to be patient, gentle, and understanding? Are you willing to lose sleep and keep going even when you’re tired? Are you willing to stay calm and not react in stressful circumstances? Are you willing to lead and guide a wife and children, eternal souls, through this life?

But my plea is that you would volunteer and say, “I’m willing to apply myself to the Word of God, the will of God, the plan of God, and I’ll give my life. I’m willing to lay it on the altar.” Jesus gave His life for us, and He’s comparing the marriage with the church and Him.

There’s also a need for mothers who are submissive and yielded to authority. Mothers who do not follow the women’s lib of our day but are rather content to be keepers at home.

Young ladies, are you willing to enlist? Will you give your heart to be guided and led? Are you willing to follow and to cheerfully submit to your authority? Are you willing to serve and be spent for your family? Are you willing to serve and be spent for YOUR family? If you get married someday, it will be YOUR family that you’ll be serving and being spent for. Are you willing to bear pain and discomfort? Are you willing to be a helpmeet, giving yourself for his burden and vision?

But as we look at God’s plan and blessings, you want God’s blessing, young people! But that means you need to make choices accordingly. Rise up and make decisions that will lead to maturity. Maturity comes with the process of seeking after God. Make a commitment in your heart to open yourself to God’s blessings and principles. I encourage you to walk with God, to have a relationship with Jesus Christ, and to do so in humility.

Seek after Christlike character, and do it on purpose. It is so easy for us to just live life however it happens. But if we make decisions on purpose, it will take us somewhere! Those decisions matter. Do things according to God’s plan.

God has a plan for male and female and he has a plan for you.

Um Namoro Centrado em Cristo é uma série de mensagens sobre namoro piedoso pregadas por Paul Hershberger. Ele pregou essas mensagens várias vezes em diferentes locais ao longo dos últimos dez anos. Recentemente, as transcrevemos e as abreviamos para clareza na leitura. Depois de imprimir todos os seis artigos em O Pulsar do Remanescente, publicaremos-os em um livreto. Este é o primeiro de seis artigos.

Introdução

Minha esposa e eu tivemos o privilégio de ter um namoro sem arrependimentos nem culpa. Fomos abençoados com pais que nos guiaram pelo caminho certo e nos deram oportunidades que eles mesmos não tiveram.

Se você não tem esse testemunho ou lembrança, por favor, não se culpe. Mas minha oração por você é que receba um ardente peso e visão no coração para ter isso para os seus filhos. Isso pode ser a sua recompensa.

Um namoro centrado em Cristo é um período de tempo entre a vida de solteiro e a vida de casado. As decisões que você toma nesse período vão afetá-lo pelo resto de sua vida. Com a bênção de Deus sobre sua vida, você pode chegar ao fim sem arrependimentos nem culpa.

Cinco objetivos desta série sobre Namoro Centrado em Cristo.

Objetivo nº 1. Voltar o coração dos pais para seus filhos.

Objetivo nº 2. Voltar o coração dos filhos para seus pais.

Objetivo nº 3. Que os pais recebam um peso para conduzir cada um de seus filhos ao perfeito querer de Deus para as suas vidas.

Objetivo nº 4. Que os jovens recebam um peso para buscar a Deus, encontrar realização e propósito em andar com Deus, e que busquem maturidade em seus modos e em seu caráter.

Objetivo nº 5. Que jovens homens e jovens mulheres se levantem para ser pais piedosos e mães piedosas com a visão de criar outra geração piedosa, e que o Evangelho de Jesus Cristo prossiga.

O Plano de Deus para Masculino e Feminino

Ecclesiastes 12:1 diz: “Lembra-te do teu Criador nos dias da tua mocidade, antes que venham os maus dias, e cheguem os anos dos quais dirás: Não tenho neles contentamento.” Meu desejo é que cada um de vocês se lembre do seu Criador nos dias da juventude. Voltem o coração, o foco e a vida para perseguir o seu Criador, o Deus Todo-Poderoso, no céu.

O que ele quer dizer com “antes que venham os maus dias” e “cheguem os anos”? Significa buscar o Senhor quando você é jovem. Tome a energia da sua juventude e busque a Deus. Jovens, vocês são jovens e cheios de ideias, visões, planos e sonhos. Duvido que alguém aqui goste apenas de se sentar em uma poltrona, colocar os pés para cima e apenas sonhar sobre quão terrível e horrível a vida será. Nós não somos assim, certo? Mas se não andarmos com Deus e não seguirmos o plano de Deus, coisas difíceis virão sobre nós. Quando coisas difíceis vêm na vida, não temos para onde nos voltar. Sonhamos que a vida dará certo. As decisões e ações na nossa juventude nos afetam pelo resto da vida. A boa notícia é que elas podem nos afetar de maneira boa. A má notícia é que elas podem nos afetar de maneira ruim. Depende das decisões e escolhas que fazemos. Mas jovens, vocês são jovens e têm a oportunidade de escolher.

Vamos ao princípio, em Gênesis.

“E disse o SENHOR Deus: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; far-lhe-ei uma ajudadora idônea. E formou o SENHOR Deus da terra todo animal do campo, e toda ave do céu, e os trouxe a Adão para ver como este lhes havia de chamar; e tudo quanto Adão chamou a toda criatura vivente, esse foi o seu nome. E deu Adão nomes a todo gado, e às aves do céu, e a todo animal do campo; porém para Adão não se achava ajudadora idônea. Então o SENHOR Deus fez cair um sono pesado sobre Adão, e este adormeceu; e tomou uma de suas costelas, e fechou a carne em seu lugar. E da costela que o SENHOR Deus tomou ao homem formou uma mulher, e trouxe-a a Adão. E disse Adão: Esta agora é osso dos meus ossos e carne da minha carne; ela será chamada mulher, porquanto do homem foi tomada. Portanto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e apegar-se-á à sua mulher; e serão ambos uma carne” (Gênesis 2:18-24).

“E disse Deus: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem, conforme a nossa semelhança; e domine sobre os peixes do mar, e sobre as aves do céu, e sobre o gado, e sobre toda a terra, e sobre todo réptil que se move sobre a terra. E criou Deus o homem à sua imagem; à imagem de Deus o criou; homem e mulher os criou. E Deus os abençoou; e Deus lhes disse: Sede fecundos e multiplicai-vos, e enchei a terra, e sujeitai-a; e dominai sobre os peixes do mar, e sobre as aves do céu, e sobre todo ser vivente que se move sobre a terra” (Gênesis 1:26-28).

“E disse o Senhor Deus: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; far-lhe-ei uma ajudadora idônea” (Gênesis 2:18). “Far‑lhe‑ei uma ajudadora que seja idônea para ele.” Deus disse que faria isso.

“E criou Deus o homem à sua imagem; à imagem de Deus o criou; homem e mulher os criou” (Gênesis 1:27). Deus fez. Deus criou-nos homem e mulher. É preciso muita fé cega para crer que nós evoluímos perfeitamente como homem e mulher. A criação do homem e da mulher é o plano de Deus. É uma das provas vivas da Criação. Deus fez. Deus criou. É o plano de Deus. Deus é o Autor. E o plano de Deus traz bênção.

Gostaria de olhar dez aspectos diferentes dessa bênção do plano de Deus.

1) Deus traz Eva a Adão.

“E da costela que o Senhor Deus tomou ao homem formou uma mulher, e trouxe-a ao homem. E disse Adão: Esta agora é osso dos meus ossos, e carne da minha carne; será chamada mulher, porquanto do homem foi tomada” (Gênesis 2:22-23).

Deus fez Adão cair num sono pesado. Então Deus criou Eva e a trouxe a Adão. Adão despertou e percebeu: “Esta é para mim!” Ele tinha visto todos os animais passarem enquanto lhes dava nomes. Agora Deus lhe traz alguém que é para ele. Ele também percebeu: “Ela foi tirada do meu lado.” Ela está perto do seu coração. “Esta é osso dos meus ossos e carne da minha carne.” Não é um cachorro; não é uma girafa, nem um macaco, nem um símio. Aquela que Deus lhe trouxe é semelhante a ele. O plano de Deus tem uma bênção.

Adão e Eva nunca haviam tido um companheiro antes. Adão e Eva nunca haviam entregue as emoções do coração a alguém fora. Algo aconteceu nos corações de Adão e Eva. Adão era “homem de uma só mulher”, e Eva era “mulher de um só homem.” Eles nunca deram suas paixões de coração a mais ninguém. Deus tem esse plano para nós também. O plano de Deus traz bênçãos.

2) Deixar e apegar‑se em unidade para a vida.

“Portanto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e apegar‑se‑á à sua mulher: e serão ambos uma carne” (Gênesis 2:24).

Este versículo diz: “Portanto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe”, mas Adão e Eva não tinham pai nem mãe. O que Deus está dizendo é que não funciona haver apego sem haver partida. Além disso, em Marcos 10:7 lemos: “Por causa disto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e unir‑se‑á a sua mulher.” Este é o plano de Deus, e o plano de Deus traz bênção.

Deixar significa abandonar, deixar para trás. “Por causa disto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe” é deixar os pais para trás. Consideremos um jovem que tem uma vida doméstica muito boa. Ele é abençoado e tem tudo o que precisa. Entretanto, quando Deus traz sua Eva à sua vida, algo surge dentro dele, e ele diz: “Eu vou partir!” Mas este é o plano de Deus. E o plano de Deus traz bênção.

Não é apenas deixar o pai e a mãe; ele também se apega à esposa. Apegar‑se significa “colar, aderir”. Conhecemos bem painéis de madeira colados. Todo tipo de móvel sólido é feito de painéis colados. E se forem colados corretamente, não se desfarão nas juntas. Se você os separar, terá de rasgar a madeira. A cola de Deus é assim, onde ela une duas pessoas. A única maneira de separá‑las é por estilhaçamento e rasgo, e Deus não abençoa isso. Mas deixar e apegar‑se, ficar junto e ser colado, esse é o plano de Deus e traz bênção.

3) Serão uma só carne.

“Portanto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e apegar‑se‑á à sua mulher: e serão ambos uma carne” (Gênesis 2:24). Duas pessoas solteiras que se tornam um casal casado tornam‑se uma unidade perante Deus e tornam‑se uma família diante de Deus. Tornam‑se uma só carne, onde Deus os vê unidos como um só.

“E serão dois numa só carne; assim já não são dois, mas uma só carne. Portanto, o que Deus ajuntou não o separe o homem” (Marcos 10:8-9). O plano de Deus para homem e mulher é que Ele traz Eva a Adão. Depois vem o deixar e apegar‑se. Ele faz com que se tornem uma só carne. Separar traz agonia, dor, trabalho de parto e ferida. Não há bênção na separação. Mas o plano de Deus traz bênção.

4) Não um jugo desigual.

“E não vos prendais a um jugo desigual com os infiéis; porque que sociedade tem a justiça com a injustiça?” (2 Coríntios 6:14-15). “A mulher está ligada ao marido enquanto ele vive; mas, se o marido falecer, fica livre para casar com quem quiser, contanto que seja no Senhor” (1 Coríntios 7:39).

O plano de Deus é que o casamento seja um jugo igual. Deus não trará uma Eva a um Adão num casamento que seja um jugo desigual. Vamos pensar sobre deixar e apegar‑se, unir‑se e tornar‑se um só. No casamento, esses dois agora são um perante Deus. Imagine estar num relacionamento conjugal ruim assim—uma família assim tentando funcionar junta. Não haverá bênção.

Mas um jugo igual traz bênção! Deus deseja que sejamos unidos em uma só carne, um só coração e uma só mente. Ele quer nos ver unidos em coração, mente e carne—todo o ser, sendo um. O plano de Deus traz bênção.

5) Deus planejou para que tivéssemos filhos.

“E Deus os abençoou; e Deus lhes disse: Sede fecundos e multiplicai‑vos, e enchei a terra, e sujeitai‑a; e dominai sobre os peixes do mar, e sobre as aves do céu, e sobre todo ser vivente que se move sobre a terra” (Gênesis 1:28). Pense na alegria e no milagre cada vez que mais uma criança nasce em um lar cristão. Deus planejou assim. E se Deus trouxe a Eva para Adão, e eles deixam e se apegam, tornam‑se uma só carne, um só coração, uma só mente. Se são igualmente ligados pelo jugo e Deus os abençoa com filhos, torna‑se um refúgio alegre onde Deus pode habitar. “E abençoou Deus a Noé e a seus filhos, e lhes disse: Sede fecundos e multiplicai‑vos, e enchei a terra” (Gênesis 9:1). “E quanto a vós, sede fecundos e multiplicai‑vos; frutificai na terra e multiplicai‑vos nela” (Gênesis 9:7). O plano de Deus traz bênção.

6) Ordem de autoridade.

“Mas quero que saibais que Cristo é a cabeça de todo homem, sendo ele próprio a cabeça da mulher, e Deus a cabeça de Cristo” (1 Coríntios 11:3). É Deus, e depois Cristo, o homem, e a mulher. Deus estabeleceu uma ordem de autoridade, e essa ordem de autoridade é uma bênção. É o plano de Deus, e é uma bênção.

“Filhos, obedecei a vossos pais no Senhor, porque isso é justo. Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe (que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa), para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra” (Efésios 6:1-3). Crianças, obedecer a seus pais no Senhor faz parte da ordem de autoridade. Isso não é difícil de entender, é? Um lar que segue o plano de Deus é simplesmente uma situação abençoada. Jovens aprendem a estar sob autoridade. Façam disso sua prioridade máxima. Quanto mais cedo aprenderem a estar sob autoridade, melhor preparados estarão para as responsabilidades da vida.

Lembro‑me de olhar para a vida de casado e ter aspirações sobre ensinar crianças e criar uma família piedosa. Ouvi a série “Lar Piedoso” e pensei que estava pronto. Mas então veio o dia em que foi minha vez e minha responsabilidade, e de repente meu coração quis murchar. Responsabilidade não parece o mesmo que sonhar com isso. VOCÊ precisa fazer algo! VOCÊ é responsável. VOCÊ precisa fazer acontecer. E, a propósito, não apenas fazer acontecer; você precisa fazer acontecer de modo cristão. Você precisa fazer acontecer de uma forma em que a unção do Espírito de Deus possa descer sobre sua família. Quanto melhor aprendermos a estar sob autoridade, melhor preparados estaremos para essas responsabilidades. Quanto mais percebermos que precisamos de Deus, melhor seremos. Façamos uma alta prioridade de aprender a estar sob autoridade como crianças e como jovens. “Meu filho, não te esqueças da minha lei; e o teu coração guarde os meus mandamentos; porque eles aumentarão os teus dias e te acrescentarão anos de vida e paz” (Provérbios 3:1-2).

Deus acrescentará sua bênção se permanecermos nessa ordem de autoridade. Quanto mais você aprender a estar sob autoridade, mais será abençoado ao estabelecer seu lar. O plano de Deus tem bênçãos.

7) Um casamento piedoso.

Efésios 5:21,22,24 diz: “Sujeitai‑vos uns aos outros no temor de Deus. Vós, mulheres, sujeitai‑vos a vossos próprios maridos, como ao Senhor. . . Assim como a igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres o sejam em tudo a seus maridos.”

Antes de tudo olhe para o versículo 21, “sujeitai‑vos uns aos outros.” Há uma fusão que precisa acontecer num lar piedoso. Essa fusão deve ocorrer no temor de Deus. Se nos sujeitamos uns aos outros no temor de Deus, obedeceremos a Deus porque queremos suas bênçãos.

Efésios 5:22,24 “Vós, mulheres, sujeitai‑vos a vossos próprios maridos, como ao Senhor. . . Assim como a igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres o sejam em tudo a seus maridos.” Jovens mulheres, podem contar com isto: submissão ao pai é igual à submissão ao marido. Vocês podem praticar enquanto estão solteiras. Isso ajudará a formar caráter em sua vida. Ser uma mulher rebelde e contumaz não trará a bênção de Deus.

Segue e diz, em Efésios 5:25,28,29: “Maridos, amai vossas mulheres, como também Cristo amou a igreja, e se entregou por ela . . . Assim devem os maridos amar as suas próprias mulheres como a seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua mulher, ama‑se a si mesmo. Porque nunca ninguém odiou a sua própria carne, antes a sustenta e alimenta, como também o Senhor à igreja.” Jovens homens, isto diz que os maridos devem amar as suas mulheres. Então, quem vocês acham que Deus colocou na vossa vida para prepará‑los a amar a esposa? A vossa mãe! Querem aprender a amar a vossa futura esposa? Aprendam a conviver com a sua mãe, a amar a sua mãe e a cuidar dela. Querem praticar para amar a futura esposa? Amem a mãe.

Versículo 33, “Todavia, cada um de vós ame também a sua mulher como a si mesmo; e a mulher reverencie o marido.” O plano de Deus traz bênçãos.

8) Ser herdeiros juntos da graça da vida.

1 Pedro 3:7 “Igualmente vós, maridos, vivei com elas com conhecimento, dando honra à mulher, como vaso mais fraco; como sendo vós os seus cooperadores na graça da vida; para que não sejam impedidas as vossas orações.” Como maridos, damos honra à mulher. Ela é o vaso mais fraco e a que deu à luz as crianças! Ela passou por muitas mudanças traumáticas em sua vida. É a que se desgasta e se cansa mais cedo.

E ele diz: “Maridos, vivei com elas com conhecimento.”

Jovens homens, aprendam a compreender a sua mãe e as vossas irmãs. Isso ajudará depois que se casarem. Não concluam que—ah, isso é só coisa de mulher. Não, vocês querem a bênção de Deus. Aprendam a conhecê‑las e compreendê‑las.

“Sendo herdeiros juntos da graça da vida.” Deus quer que sejamos herdeiros juntos da graça da vida. Se não formos herdeiros juntos da graça da vida, podemos ser herdeiros separados da graça da vida? Não creio. Ele diz que devemos ser herdeiros juntos para que as vossas orações não sejam impedidas. Então, se formos herdeiros separados, poderíamos dizer que nossas orações serão impedidas? Sim, nossas orações serão impedidas. Demos honra à mulher como ao vaso mais fraco. Cada voto de atenção que vocês ganharem nesta área só os abençoará mais tarde. Vale a pena. O plano de Deus traz bênção.

9) Um lar abençoado e seguro.

Isto vem em parte de 1 Pedro 3:7, mas também do Salmo 144:12: “Para que os nossos filhos sejam como plantas crescidas na sua juventude; para que as nossas filhas sejam como cantarias, lavradas à semelhança de um palácio.” A graça de Deus está sobre um lar seguro onde existe unidade. Onde o pai compreende a mãe, onde o pai se importa com a mãe. O pai ministra e está lá para ajudar e guiar. Ele está ali para dar direção com um coração de compaixão. O plano de Deus para homem e mulher—o plano de Deus traz bênçãos.

10) Como Cristo e a igreja.

“Assim como a igreja submeteu‑se a Cristo, assim também as mulheres o sejam a seus maridos em tudo. Maridos, amai vossas mulheres, como também Cristo amou a igreja e se entregou por ela; para a santificar, purificando‑a com a lavagem da água, pela palavra; para a apresentar a si mesmo igreja gloriosa, sem mancha, nem ruga, nem coisa semelhante; mas santa e irrepreensível. Assim devem os maridos amar as suas próprias mulheres como a seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua mulher, ama‑se a si mesmo. Porque nunca ninguém odiou a sua própria carne; antes a sustenta e alimenta, como também Cristo à igreja” (Efésios 5:24-29).

“Maridos, amai vossas mulheres, como também Cristo amou a igreja e se entregou por ela.” Deus está procurando homens dispostos a entregar suas vidas. Jovens solteiros, que estejam dispostos a atender ao chamado e a dar a vida. Esta é uma alta vocação de Deus. É o plano de Deus.

Jovens homens, estais dispostos a derramar a vossa vida, a vossa agenda e aquelas coisas independentes que gostais de fazer? Estais dispostos a ser pacientes, gentis e compreensivos? Estais dispostos a perder sono e continuar mesmo quando estais cansados? Estais dispostos a permanecer calmos e não reagir em circunstâncias estressantes? Estais dispostos a liderar e guiar uma esposa e filhos, almas eternas, por esta vida?

Mas meu apelo é que vos voluntarieis e digais: “Estou disposto a aplicar‑me à Palavra de Deus, ao querer de Deus, ao plano de Deus, e darei a minha vida. Estou disposto a colocá‑la sobre o altar.” Jesus deu a sua vida por nós, e Ele compara o casamento com a igreja e consigo mesmo.

Há também necessidade de mães que sejam submissas e rendidas à autoridade. Mães que não sigam a liberação feminina do nosso tempo, mas que antes estejam contentes em ser mantenedoras do lar.

Jovens mulheres, estais dispostas a alistar‑vos? Entregareis o vosso coração para ser guiado e liderado? Estais dispostas a seguir e a submeter‑vos alegremente à vossa autoridade? Estais dispostas a servir e a gastar‑vos pela vossa família? Estais dispostas a servir e a gastar‑vos pela VOSSA família? Se algum dia vos casardes, será A VOSSA família que servireis e para a qual vos gastareis. Estais dispostas a suportar dor e desconforto? Estais dispostas a ser uma ajudadora idônea, entregando‑vos ao seu fardo e visão?

Mas ao olharmos para o plano e as bênçãos de Deus, vocês querem a bênção de Deus, jovens! Mas isso significa que precisam tomar decisões em conformidade. Levantai‑vos e tomai decisões que conduzam à maturidade. A maturidade vem com o processo de buscar a Deus. Comprometam o coração a abrir‑se às bênçãos e princípios de Deus. Encorajo‑vos a andar com Deus, a ter um relacionamento com Jesus Cristo e a fazê‑lo em humildade.

Busquem o caráter semelhante ao de Cristo, e façam‑no de propósito. É tão fácil para nós viver a vida como ela acontece. Mas se fizermos decisões intencionais, elas nos levarão a algum lugar! Essas decisões importam. Façam as coisas de acordo com o plano de Deus.

Deus tem um plano para o masculino e o feminino e tem um plano para você.
